current.text: The Kings are projected to start Simmons, reportedly over DeAndre Hunter.
Centers Dylan Cardwell and Maxime Raynaud are both out for at least two weeks.
Simmons may get some small-ball minutes at center while the Kings are short on bigs.
As a starter, experts see a line of about 6 rebounds and 6 assists as possible.
Experts disagree on drafting him. One calls him a late swing in category leagues. Another does not want him.
His draft position in mock drafts is rising. He went 131st in one mock.
He should be worth streaming at times this season.
The Kings are expected to be one of the worst teams in the NBA, and their rotations are hard to predict.
The Kings play 11 games in our playoff weeks (4-4-3) and have 14 back-to-backs this season.

durable.text: He cannot shoot and makes almost no threes. He scores very little.
He plays with very low usage.
His fantasy value comes from rebounds and assists, and he plays good defense.
One expert doubts his body can handle 60 games.

note: Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 174, ESPN rank 322), and nobody drafted him in our league last season. He sits right around our 144-player cutoff, so at most he is a 1 USD late flyer, mainly for rebounds and assists. He gives you no threes and almost no points. In the first weeks, check whether he really starts and gets minutes (ESPN projects 21.2), whether he plays small-ball center while Cardwell and Raynaud are out, and how often the Kings rest him. If he is not drafted, keep him on your waiver watch list for streaming.
